Nov 12, 2026 13:45:00

Runway, an American generative AI company that develops video generation AIs such as the '

Runway ' series and video editing AI ' Aleph 2.0 ,' has announced ' Praxis-1, ' an open-weight world action model that translates pre-trained video data into control for actual robots.

Praxis-1: From Video Pretraining to Robot Control | Runway Research
https://runway.com/research/praxis-1-video-pretraining-to-robot-control

Today, we're making Praxis-1 available to everyone. Our state-of-the-art world action model turns video pretraining into control for real robots, and it ships with open weights under Apache 2.0, ready to run and fine-tune on your own hardware. pic.twitter.com/jL5ZmpY6x9

— Runway (@runwayml) November 11, 2026

Runway Praxis-1 Is Now Available: Open-Weight Robotics Model
https://runway.com/news/company-news/praxis-1-is-now-available

Developing AI for robot control requires a large amount of data on robot movements, but collecting this data is very costly. Therefore, Runway believed that 'the most scalable data source is the general video that people film every day,' and trained an AI model to predict the behavior of objects, hand movements, and work processes from video.

This is how Praxis-1 was born. Praxis-1 is based on Runway's video-based model with 27 billion parameters and can be run locally. An NVFP4 quantization model that can run on an NVIDIA GeForce 5090 is also available.

@Runwayml 's Praxis-1 is a 27B-parameter open-weight world action model that is optimized to run locally on NVIDIA RTX 5090.

Praxis-1 is a leading world action model on NVIDIA's RoboLab-120 leaderboard.

Download the NVFP4 checkpoint on Hugging Face: https://t.co/ZPN2Kw7ww7 https://t.co/DJ2gs84w0f

— NVIDIA RTX Spark (@NVIDIARTXSpark) November 11, 2026

Praxis-1 transforms the future into an 'open-weighted world model' that predicts the future in short units, with a small action expert reading the internal state of the video-based model and imagining what will happen next. Every time the robot takes action, Praxis-1 predicts both how the scene will look and the movements needed to get there. By incorporating a step of 'learning how the world works from video' before learning specific actions, it functions as a broadly adaptable model for robots.

To evaluate Praxis-1, the '

Robolab-120 ,' used as a benchmark for robot motion control, and the robotic arm of ' FRANKA RESEARCH 3, ' a robotic system specialized in robotics and AI, were used. As a result, Praxis-1 solved 555 out of 1200 scenarios (46.2%), and was reported to have achieved the best performance in both the 'World Behavioral Model' and the 'Open Source Robot Base Model' on the leaderboard. In a task using FRANKA RESEARCH 3 with 10 single-item scenarios published by ' FLUX 3 Action ,' the world behavioral model for robot control that had previously recorded the highest score, Praxis-1 scored '88,' surpassing FLUX 3 Action's '80.'

Furthermore, cutting-edge multimodal models allow for zero-shot operation of robotic arms via tools and code interfaces. OpenAI's '

GPT-6 Astra ,' announced in September 2026, achieved a 22.5% success rate in the robot object manipulation benchmark ' RoboDojo ,' surpassing all public entries and becoming a leader on the Robolab-120 leaderboard. However, multimodal models have drawbacks compared to global behavior models, namely latency and cost. In fact, when Runway ran Praxis-1 and GPT-6 Astra on the same three tasks, GPT-6 Astra took an average of 15.6 times longer to complete the tasks, and the cost per completed task was 51 times higher.

Runway has released several videos demonstrating how Praxis-1 and FRANKA RESEARCH 3 perform tasks such as 'putting specified items into bags or plates,' 'turning mugs upside down and placing them on trays,' and 'closing box lids.' Runway emphasizes that 'it's not just about achieving top benchmark scores, but also about demonstrating real-world examples of robots performing everyday tasks.'

Runway stated, 'We want to understand whether a model predicting its own future is also an indicator of task success. While these test results are in the early stages, they still point in the direction we value most: a model that learns from its own video predictions by evaluating and improving its own behavior using an imagined future. We are actively researching this direction with the aim of creating a truly self-improving global behavior model. We will continue to invest in global behavior model research, focusing particularly on long-term thinking, proactive planning, and the self-improvement loop.'

Praxis-1 is released under the Apache License 2.0 by Hugging Face.

Praxis-1 - a runwayml Collection
https://huggingface.co/collections/runwayml/praxis-1

Additionally, the related code is available on GitHub.

GitHub - runwayml/praxis-1-oss · GitHub
https://github.com/runwayml/praxis-1-oss

translation.html:
2026年11月12日 13:45:00

美国生成式 AI 公司 Runway 开发了视频生成 AI，例如“

Runway”系列，以及视频编辑 AI“Aleph 2.0”。该公司宣布推出“Praxis-1”，这是一款开放权重的世界动作模型，可将预训练视频数据转化为对真实机器人的控制。

Praxis-1：从视频预训练到机器人控制 | Runway Research
https://runway.com/research/praxis-1-video-pretraining-to-robot-control

今天，我们向所有人开放 Praxis-1。我们这款最先进的世界动作模型将视频预训练转化为对真实机器人的控制，并依据 Apache 2.0 许可证开放权重，可直接在你自己的硬件上运行和微调。pic.twitter.com/jL5ZmpY6x9

— Runway (@runwayml) November 11, 2026

Runway Praxis-1 现已推出：开放权重的机器人模型
https://runway.com/news/company-news/praxis-1-is-now-available

开发用于机器人控制的 AI 需要大量机器人运动数据，但收集这些数据的成本非常高。因此，Runway 认为，“最具可扩展性的数据来源是人们每天拍摄的普通视频”，并训练了一个 AI 模型，使其能够从视频中预测物体的行为、手部动作和工作流程。

Praxis-1 就是这样诞生的。Praxis-1 基于 Runway 拥有 270 亿参数的视频模型，可在本地运行。此外，还提供了可在 NVIDIA GeForce 5090 上运行的 NVFP4 量化模型。

@Runwayml 的 Praxis-1 是一款拥有 270 亿参数的开放权重世界动作模型，经过优化，可在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上本地运行。

Praxis-1 是 NVIDIA RoboLab-120 排行榜上领先的世界动作模型。

在 Hugging Face 上下载 NVFP4 检查点：https://t.co/ZPN2Kw7ww7 https://t.co/DJ2gs84w0f

— NVIDIA RTX Spark (@NVIDIARTXSpark) November 11, 2026

Praxis-1 将未来转化为一个以较短时间单元预测未来的“开放权重世界模型”，其中一个小型动作专家会读取视频模型的内部状态，并想象接下来会发生什么。机器人每次采取行动时，Praxis-1 都会同时预测场景将呈现的样子，以及达到该场景所需的动作。通过在学习具体动作之前加入“从视频中学习世界如何运作”的步骤，它成为了一款适应范围广泛的机器人模型。

为评估 Praxis-1，研究人员使用了“

Robolab-120”这一机器人运动控制基准，以及专用于机器人技术和 AI 的机器人系统“FRANKA RESEARCH 3”的机械臂。结果，Praxis-1 解决了 1200 个场景中的 555 个（46.2%），据报告，它在排行榜的“世界行为模型”和“开源机器人基础模型”两类中均取得了最佳表现。在使用 FRANKA RESEARCH 3 完成此前得分最高的机器人控制世界行为模型“FLUX 3 Action”公布的 10 个单物品场景任务时，Praxis-1 获得了“88”分，超过了 FLUX 3 Action 的“80”分。

此外，前沿多模态模型能够通过工具和代码接口，以零样本方式操作机械臂。OpenAI 的“

GPT-6 Astra”于 2026 年 9 月发布，在机器人物体操作基准“RoboDojo”中取得了 22.5% 的成功率，超过所有公开参评模型，并成为 Robolab-120 排行榜上的领先者。然而，与全局行为模型相比，多模态模型在延迟和成本方面存在劣势。事实上，当 Runway 让 Praxis-1 和 GPT-6 Astra 执行相同的三项任务时，GPT-6 Astra 完成任务所需的平均时间为前者的 15.6 倍，每完成一项任务的成本则为前者的 51 倍。

Runway 发布了多段视频，展示 Praxis-1 与 FRANKA RESEARCH 3 如何执行“将指定物品放入袋子或盘子中”“将马克杯倒置并放到托盘上”以及“合上盒盖”等任务。Runway 强调，“这不仅关乎取得最高的基准测试分数，也关乎展示机器人执行日常任务的真实案例。”

Runway 表示：“我们希望了解，模型对自身未来的预测是否也能成为任务成功与否的指标。尽管这些测试结果仍处于早期阶段，但它们依然指向我们最重视的方向：一个利用想象中的未来来评估和改进自身行为，从而从自身视频预测中学习的模型。我们正在积极研究这一方向，目标是打造真正能够自我改进的全局行为模型。我们将继续投入全局行为模型研究，尤其关注长期思考、主动规划和自我改进循环。”

Praxis-1 由 Hugging Face 依据 Apache License 2.0 发布。

Praxis-1 - runwayml 的一个合集
https://huggingface.co/collections/runwayml/praxis-1

此外，相关代码已在 GitHub 上公开。
